note: Tillmann describes the community's reaction to the Navier–Stokes claim and the October release, from excitement to anger and mourning, and asks the AI companies for clarity on how prior work and mathematicians' ideas entered their outputs. She calls for support for early-career mathematicians, affirms that there will be future ICMs and Fields Medals, and sets out the IMU's role in an open international debate.
title: Mathematics in a time of change (IMU News 139 editorial)
who: Ulrike Tillmann (Oxford), President-Elect of the International Mathematical Union
